group_trips.title: Phuket, Phi Phi and Krabi Group Trip
group_trips.summary: Seven days on the Andaman coast with Phuket's old town, a Phi Phi Islands boat day and island time around Krabi, travelling in a small group.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip covers the best of Thailand's Andaman coast over six nights, three in Phuket and three in Krabi. You see Phuket Town, Wat Chalong and the Big Buddha, spend a day among the Phi Phi Islands by speedboat, then travel by road to Krabi.

In Krabi you explore the coast by longtail boat, relax on Railay Beach and visit Tiger Cave Temple. A trip captain travels with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.

The pace is easy, with free time on most days, which suits families, friends travelling together and senior parents.

group_trips.title: Bangkok and Chiang Mai Temples and Elephants Group Trip
group_trips.summary: Six days pairing Bangkok's palaces and street food with the temples and hills of Chiang Mai, including an ethical elephant sanctuary visit.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs Thailand's capital with its northern cultural centre over five nights. In Bangkok you see the Grand Palace and Wat Pho and take a boat ride on the Chao Phraya river. You then fly to Chiang Mai to explore its walled Old City, visit Doi Suthep temple and spend a morning at an elephant sanctuary.

The flights between Bangkok and Chiang Mai are included in the price, so there are no long road journeys. A trip captain accompanies the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.

Chiang Mai is cooler and calmer than Bangkok, which makes this a good choice for travellers who want culture as well as city energy.

Boat ride on the Chao Phraya river
Walled Old City of Chiang Mai, with Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh

Visit to an ethical elephant sanctuary, with no elephant riding

honeymoon_trips.title: Phuket and Krabi Honeymoon: Island Days, Longtail Boats and Candlelit Beaches
honeymoon_trips.summary: Five unhurried nights for two on Thailand's Andaman coast, with Phuket's old town, a Phi Phi Islands boat day, a private longtail trip to Railay Beach, a couples spa session and a candlelight dinner.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This private honeymoon pairs the two best-loved beach destinations on Thailand's Andaman coast: three nights in Phuket and two in Krabi. You travel by private car throughout, start most mornings late, and keep every afternoon and evening for each other.

Phuket brings the Sino-Portuguese shophouses of its old town, the Big Buddha and a full boat day among the cliffs and lagoons of the Phi Phi Islands. Krabi is quieter, with limestone headlands, clear water and a private longtail boat trip to Railay Beach that ends with the light turning gold over the sea.

Expect a flower welcome or bed decoration on arrival, a couples spa session and a candlelight dinner by the sea, all subject to availability. Tell us your wedding date at booking and we will pass it to the hotels.

honeymoon_trips.summary: Six relaxed nights for two, pairing Bangkok's Grand Palace and a Chao Phraya dinner cruise with four nights in Phuket, including a Phi Phi Islands boat day, a couples spa session and a candlelight dinner.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This private honeymoon begins in the capital and ends on the beach. Two nights in Bangkok give you the Grand Palace and Wat Pho with a private guide, followed by an evening dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya river, then you fly south to Phuket for four slow nights by the sea.

In Phuket you spend a day among the cliffs and lagoons of the Phi Phi Islands, explore the old town, the Big Buddha and Wat Chalong by private car, and keep a full day free for the beach, the pool and each other. Mornings start late and every day has just one main outing.

Your stay includes a flower or cake welcome and bed decoration, a couples spa session and a candlelight dinner, all subject to availability. Please share your wedding date at booking so the hotels can arrange the welcome.
highlights: Grand Palace and Wat Pho with a private guide
Evening dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya river
Four nights by the sea in Phuket, with a sea-view room where available
Speedboat day among the Phi Phi Islands, with lunch
Phuket Old Town, Wat Chalong and the Big Buddha by private car
Couples spa session and a candlelight dinner
Flower or cake welcome and bed decoration on arrival

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Welcome
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Bangkok, where your private car is waiting.
Transfer to your hotel and check in.
A flower or cake welcome and bed decoration are arranged, subject to availability.
Spend the evening at leisure, with dinner at a restaurant of your choice.
Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Grand Palace | Wat Pho | Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description:
After a relaxed breakfast, meet your private guide at around 10 am.
Visit the Grand Palace, the former royal residence, and Wat Pho, home of the huge reclining Buddha.
Return to the hotel to rest through the afternoon.
In the evening, enjoy a dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya river, subject to availability.
Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Fly to Phuket | Evening by the Sea
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and transfer privately to the airport for your flight to Phuket.
On arrival, your private car takes you to your beach hotel, where you check in.
The afternoon and evening are free for the beach and a quiet dinner.
Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, transfer to the pier and board a speedboat to the Phi Phi Islands.
See the cliffs and lagoons, with swimming and snorkelling stops, subject to sea conditions.
Lunch is served during the tour.
Return to Phuket by late afternoon, with a free evening.
Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket Old Town | Big Buddha | Couples Spa
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast, with a late start at around 10 am.
Your private car takes you to Phuket Old Town, with its Sino-Portuguese shophouses, then to Wat Chalong and the Big Buddha.
Return to the hotel for a couples spa session, subject to availability.
The evening is free.
Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Free Day by the Sea | Candlelight Dinner
itinerary.description:
Today has no fixed plans, so sleep in and spend the day on the beach or by the pool.
Optional island or sunset activities can be added on request.
In the evening, enjoy a candlelight dinner by the sea, subject to availability.
Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Departure from Phuket
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and a last walk on the beach.
Check out of the hotel.
Your private car takes you to Phuket Airport for your flight home.

inclusions: 2 nights hotel accommodation in Bangkok on twin sharing
4 nights hotel accommodation in Phuket on twin sharing, with a sea-view room where available
Daily breakfast at the hotel
Flower or cake welcome and bed decoration on arrival, subject to availability
One candlelight dinner by the sea in Phuket, subject to availability
Chao Phraya river dinner cruise in Bangkok, subject to availability
One couples spa session in Phuket, subject to availability
Private guide for the Grand Palace and Wat Pho
Phi Phi Islands speedboat tour with lunch
Private airport and inter-city transfers and private-car sightseeing as per itinerary
Assistance from our travel experts
exclusions: International and domestic airfare, including the Bangkok to Phuket flight
Visa fees and processing, where applicable
Travel insurance
Meals not mentioned in the itinerary
Personal expenses, laundry, tips and porterage
Optional tours and activities
Local city or tourism taxes payable at the hotel, where applicable
Anything not listed under inclusions
GST and TCS as applicable
notes: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of travel.
Please share your marriage certificate or wedding date at booking so the hotels can arrange the welcome.
Honeymoon touches are subject to availability and hotel policy.
The Bangkok to Phuket flight is not included; we can arrange it on request, and domestic baggage limits are usually lower than on international flights.
Standard hotel check-in is around 2 pm and check-out around 12 noon.
The order of the itinerary may change due to weather or operational conditions, without reducing the sights covered.
Rates are indicative and confirmed at the time of booking.
Cancellation and refund are as per our Terms & Conditions.
The Grand Palace and temples require covered shoulders and knees; guests who are not dressed appropriately may be refused entry.
Phuket's rainy season runs roughly from May to October; boat trips depend on sea conditions.
must_carry: Passport and visa copies, where applicable
Marriage certificate or wedding invitation, for the hotel welcome
Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees
